description: Time-aware history of an entity: the source's revision log (when, which properties, which kind of edit), when the entity was created, and with as_of the facts the source stated at that past date compared to today (changed, added, removed per property). Plus attribute changes YRUZ observed itself. Source revision dates are when a claim was recorded, not when it became true; effective dates come from qualifiers. Price: 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"reality_get_history"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/reality/history?id=Q7624104&as_of=2023-01-01

as_of.description: past date YYYY-MM-DD to compare with now

property.description: only edits of this property, e.g. P1128
